.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r2/task/environment/instructions/integration.md (full); other five notes by targeted search
evidence: Source comparison: every launch assumption in tests/test.sh is stated to the agent. Entry: test.sh:68 requires /app/server.js and test.sh:111 runs `node "$APP_ENTRY"`; integration.md:3 says 'We start it with node /app/server.js'. Working directory: verifier WORKDIR is /tests (tests/Dockerfile:45); integration.md:3 says 'from a working directory that may be outside /app. Resolve files from their actual location'. Port and bind: test.sh:108 PORT="3000" and probes on 127.0.0.1:3000 (test.sh:48); integration.md:3 'Listen on 0.0.0.0:3000'. Liveness: test.sh:48 probes /api/health then /, accepting any HTTP answer; integration.md:3 'serve the workspace at / and answer GET /api/health promptly'; instruction.md:5 'serve the workspace at /'. DB_PATH and writable copy: test.sh:97-102,109 set DB_PATH to /app/app.db or /tmp/submission/app.db and may launch from the copy; integration.md:9 'default database path is /app/app.db. If DB_PATH is set, open that absolute path instead, including when the app runs from a writable copy outside /app'. Deps: test.sh:106 NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules; integration.md:5 'supplies Node 22, Express and better-sqlite3 through NODE_PATH ... must not require an install or build step'; express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 are pinned identically in environment/Dockerfile:10-11 and tests/Dockerfile:20-21. Symlinks: test.sh:72-83 matches integration.md:11. Restart helper (test.sh:160-167) relaunches on the same DB_PATH; integration.md:7,9 require survival of complete process restarts. Seed: /assets/seed_data.json is named in instruction.md:3 and integration.md:7, holds no snippets, and app_context.md:21 tells judges not to assume an empty library, so a database left by the agent's own testing is not penalised. No fixed clock, account or same-origin assumption exists in test.sh or app_context.md:10. test.sh and both Dockerfiles are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff clean). Unstated but harmless harness facts: uid 65534, env -i, HOME=/tmp/submission, 30-second readiness window (test.sh:104-122); test.sh chowns /app to 65534 or falls back to the writable copy, so an app following integration.md is not broken by them. Broken app tried: one ignoring DB_PATH still writes /app/app.db when /app is writable and is not caught by launch, but that is persistence grading, not a contract mismatch. Conforming alternative tried: an app vendoring its own node_modules under /app and ignoring PORT launches correctly. Risk stays true because no measured run exercised this launch path: run_golden.sh:24 starts the golden as root with `cd / && exec node /app/server.js`, without env -i, DB_PATH, setpriv or the separate verifier image, and no full configured verifier run exists in the evidence index.
